# SheRides

> SheRides (https://sherides.online/) is a women-only ride-sharing service in Bangladesh: rides by women, for women. Passengers can book now, pre-book, or hire by the hour; women riders can apply to drive.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://sherides.online/)
- [About](https://sherides.online/about)
- [Contact](https://sherides.online/contact)
- [Privacy](https://sherides.online/privacy)
